title: HSK2 Gate 3 · Western Zhou
explanationEn: Gate 3: Western Zhou. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第3关：西周。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。西周的王想让大家都听他的话。所以他说了一句很有名的话。他说：“是天让我做王的。”
passageEn: After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou. The Western Zhou king wanted everyone to listen to him. So he said something that became very famous. He said: "It is Heaven that made me king."

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou.
comprehension.answer: 商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: So he said something that became very famous.
comprehension.answer: 所以他说了一句很有名的话。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Western Zhou in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说西周。
